title: CLCON/298/2013 of Mangal Singh Vs Virendra Singh Gusain AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 298 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. S.K. Posti, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Amar Shukla, Advocate for the opposite
parties.
For the reasons stated, compliance affidavit
is taken on record.
Mr. Amar Shukla, Advocate for the opposite
parties submits that order passed in the writ petition
has already been complied with, therefore, order
dated 20.06.2014 issuing bailable warrants may be
recalled.
For the reasons stated, order dated
20.06.2014 passed by this Court is hereby recalled.
Learned counsel for the parties fairly
submits that since order has already been complied
by the opposite parties, present contempt
application has rendered infructuous.
Ordered accordingly.
CLMA Nos. 2237, 6545 and 6546 of 2014
stand disposed of.
